<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.13.4 -->

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix: enforce component logging policy by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16476
* fix(mcp): require credentials for project file resources by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16477
* fix(mcp): require an active project owner by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16478
* fix(mcp): scope tool caches to Langflow sessions by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16500
* fix(mcp): keep component header overrides out of the saved server config by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16502
* fix: tighten custom component import policy by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16530
* fix: retire the legacy Dotenv runtime component by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16531
* fix: extend the component filesystem policy by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16532
* fix: recognize Azure subscription headers in flow redaction by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16533
* fix: require saved canvas for background builds by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16534
* fix: apply the shared code execution policy to ToolGuard by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16535
* fix: reserve Kafka plugin configuration settings by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16536
* fix: enforce credential destinations for provider components by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16537
* fix: enforce flow publication decisions across anonymous access by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16538
* fix: pin NVIDIA provider connections to validated addresses by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16546
* fix(deps): dependency upgrades for 1.13.4 by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16541
* fix(jobs): stamp the finish time on every cancel path (1.13.4) by @ogabrielluiz in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16558
* fix(lfx): preserve model responses when token usage is missing by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16560
* fix(mcp): reserve Docker client environment settings by default by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16563
* fix: apply the embedded database policy to SQLite imports by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16564
* fix(flows): apply credential redaction to forks and replacement receipts by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16566
* fix: apply credential destination policy to unified model providers by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16565
* fix(mcp): require an explicit project authentication mode by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16567
* fix(deps): refresh security dependencies for 1.13.4 by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16569
* fix: block unsafe object resolvers in generated components by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16572
### 📝 Documentation Updates
* docs: fix ejected TabItemPanel by @mendonk in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16514
### ✅ Tests
* test: cover component policy for inbound webhook jobs by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16545


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/compare/v1.13.3...v1.13.4
